index-page.title: Software Developer & Backend Engineer
index-page.intro: I build reliable backend services, data integration systems, and cloud workflows with Python, SQL, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, and AWS.

about-page.text-1: Hey, I'm Daniel. I'm a Software Developer focused on backend services, data integration, and reliable Python and SQL systems.
about-page.text-2: I graduated from the University of Maryland with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (GPA: 3.5) in May 2025.
about-page.text-3: My stack includes Python, SQL, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, PySpark, and AWS for building reliable systems end to end.

tools.title: Tools
tools.text: These are the tools I use daily for data analysis and building data pipelines. I'm always exploring new technologies to improve my workflow.
tools.python: My primary language for data processing, analysis, and automation. I use Pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn extensively.
tools.sql: Essential for data extraction and transformation. I work with MySQL, PostgreSQL, and optimize complex queries for performance.
tools.powerbi: My go-to tool for creating interactive dashboards and business intelligence reports connected to various data sources.
tools.aws: I use AWS services like Glue, Lambda, and EC2 for building scalable ETL pipelines and deploying data applications.

1.title: Graduated from University of Maryland
1.description: Completed Bachelor of Science in Computer Science with a 3.5 GPA. Coursework included Algorithms, Software Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, and Data Visualization.

2.title: Software Developer at ICATT Consulting
2.description: Architected Python and SQL integration services that consolidated three financial systems into one storage layer, designed indexed relational schemas, added CI/CD validation gates, and automated real-time reconciliation—cutting processing from multiple days to under three hours.

3.title: Software Engineer at Cube Money
3.description: Built a Python identity-resolution algorithm across eight backend systems for more than 3,000 accounts, unified 15 query implementations, and automated consistency checks across 120 account groups—cutting analysis turnaround from two days to under one hour.
